answer: Standing decays sharply after 5 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The mirror decay curve is applied at each close, comet records the drop, and bridge recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. That bill is paid per identity, so 343 aliases cost 63 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
